name: I Got Nothin' Left!
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
I'm a dwarf fer cryin' out loud,  lad! I ain't been designed to fish! I mean look at me! I'm practically made outta stone.

I got nothin' left - ye tapped me out. I've taught ye all I know, flipflop!

Don't ye get it? Ah, fine. I got an ol' friend over on Kalimdor who can help ye out. 'Is name be Nat Pagle, a fine lad. Find him on the islands south o' Theramore. Git goin'!
narrative.objectives: Travel to Kalimdor, to the coastal city of Theramore. From there you must search for an island, south of the main town. Nat Pagle awaits your arrival!
narrative.offerRewardText: I've always got room on my island for visitors... I reckon...

chain.subtitle: 2 quests at level 45, 4,875 XP in all.
